title: IntentSignedOff
description: The PO signed off an intent package; from now on it is immutable. Topic hotl.intent; subject and key: the intent id. Producer: Portal. Main consumers: Orchestrator (starts the run).

repos.description: The package's repo hints, under their old name (deprecated since v0.12.0, read repoHints). Empty when the package has none; the scoper decides the run's repos (ADR 0018).

repoHints.description: The package's repo hints (repo_hints, and repos of packages written before v0.12.0). They only guide the scoper (ADR 0018).
